claim_boundary: Task optimization fits unknown modeled dynamics on a fixed MaleCNS-derived graph. It does not train or modify biological connectivity and is not evidence that a living fly learned the task.

seed_namespace.final_test_rule: Training/development seeds are >2.1e9; final held-out/OOD seeds are generated only from 1..1,999,999,999. The namespaces are disjoint by construction.

connectome_sensory_interface.basis_drive_definition: signed dot product of airflow-arrival vector with unit vectors at +45 and -45 degrees; opposite-direction airflow may therefore produce negative modeled drive
connectome_sensory_interface.role_population_policy: For v1, wind basis roles are restricted to retained E001 PFNa/PFNm source neurons with explicit L/R instance identity. Retained PFNp and other side-unresolved PFN candidates remain structural evidence but are excluded from sensory drive roles until their laterality is independently resolved.
connectome_sensory_interface.rationale: Currier et al. 2020 found ventral P-FNs in each hemisphere tuned around 45 degrees ipsilateral, forming two orthogonal airflow bases. Matheson et al. 2022 found PFNa/PFNp/PFNm carry wind direction while odor-sensitive FB tangential inputs including FB5AB lack significant odor-direction tuning and hDeltaC combines these streams.
connectome_sensory_interface.claim_boundary: This remains a modeled sensory interface until the peripheral olfactory and mechanosensory bridges are separately body-ID-qualified.

objective.privileged_training_signal: source distance is available only to the optimizer's reward calculation and is never passed to the controller at inference

tau_s.meaning: global modeled neural relaxation time constant

recurrent_gain.meaning: global scale on recurrent connectome drive

odor_gain.meaning: tied gain on nondirectional odor-context drive to bilateral FB5AB roles

wind_basis_gain.meaning: single tied gain on the left/right signed PFN airflow-basis drives

forbidden_training_freedom: changing body IDs or role membership during optimization
independently fitting left and right odor or PFN-basis gains
injecting instantaneous left-right odor difference as a directional FB cue in v1
assigning side-unresolved PFN cells to left/right basis roles by optimizer choice
using source coordinates, distance, plume ground truth, or final-test outcomes as controller inputs

trained_e002.laterality_rule: positive body-frame downwind-y points left, so airflow arrives from the right and the upwind target is right/negative turn; negative downwind-y reverses these signs
trained_e002.memory_policy: odor-blank persistence is not part of the primary v1 qualification because the optional hDeltaK/PFG MaleCNS label hypothesis did not qualify in E001

matched_control_rule.training_budget: identical seed split, parameter bounds, population size, generation count, objective, and optimizer seed for every topology
matched_control_rule.primary_development_comparison: intact validation performance versus mean performance of separately trained rewired topologies
matched_control_rule.warning: A trained intact model must never be compared against untrained rewires as evidence that topology helps.

development_gate.interpretation: This gate only decides whether task optimization is useful enough to carry forward. It is not the final scientific claim.

final_test_policy: No final held-out or OOD episode may be evaluated until the role-review artifact, training algorithm, parameterization, trained parameter files, trained-E002 checks, and final manifest are frozen.
